body: Deployed v2.3 to production. All health checks green; CSV export is live.
The pricing page claims 99.99% uptime but we have no SLA. Owner: please confirm whether we can promise this or remove it.
Chose Postgres full-text search over Elasticsearch: one less service to run, good enough for 50k rows.
Checkpoint: still running the migration backfill, 40% done.
Production is down: the API returns 502 since the 14:10 deploy. Rolled back is blocked because the migration already ran. Investigating the connection pool.
Add rate limiting to the public search endpoint before the launch on Friday (2026-09-11).
Fix typo in the footer: 'Privcy' -> 'Privacy'.
Access check: I can read the repo and the staging database. No issues.
I need the Stripe live API key added to the production secrets before I can finish the billing rollout. Please add STRIPE_LIVE_KEY in the deployment settings.
Decided to keep the monolith for now instead of splitting billing into its own service. Reason: the team is two people and the deploy pipeline is shared; revisit at 10k customers.
Heartbeat: agent session started, syncing context.
Finished the Android table screen: pull to refresh, swipe actions, and details sheet all work on API 28 and 36. Tests pass. Next: dark mode.

Title: Qwen3 embeddings top MTEB multilingual
Why it matters: Could replace our current embedding model with better Romanian recall.
URL: https://example.com/qwen3-mteb
Renew the domain beacon.example before it expires on 2026-10-01.
Use SQLite for the offline cache on the phone; rejected Realm (licensing) and plain JSON files (no queries).
Waiting on the owner to choose between the two logo options in the handoff before I can finish the store listing.
Ran the full test suite: 412 passed, 0 failed, 3 skipped. Coverage 81%.
Found that user passwords are logged in plaintext by the debug middleware in production. Disabled the middleware; logs from the last 30 days should be purged. Should I purge them now?
Cumpără furtun de irigație de 25m și conectori.
Factura de la furnizorul de semințe: 340 lei, scadentă pe 20 septembrie.
Am ales irigație prin picurare în loc de aspersoare: consumă mai puțină apă.
Am montat jumătate din sistemul de irigație; restul săptămâna viitoare.
Migrate the auth service from Go 1.22 to 1.25, update all dependencies, and re-run the security audit across the three repositories.
Context for next session: the CSV export lives in internal/admin/export.go; tests in export_test.go. The flaky test is TestExportLargeFile on arm64.
Release v0.4.0 published with signed APK. Changelog posted.
We will not support Internet Explorer.
Can you confirm whether the onboarding emails should be sent in Romanian, English, or both?
Checkpoint saved. No changes since the last session.
Write the privacy policy page (needs legal review) and link it from the signup form.
